rules.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 path traversal / RCE
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later. 2.4.50 is also affected by the incomplete-fix follow-up CVE-2021-42013.

rules.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 path traversal / RCE
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or later.

rules.title: PHP-CGI argument injection on Windows (CVE-2024-4577)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to PHP 8.1.29 / 8.2.20 / 8.3.8 or later; avoid PHP-CGI on Windows.
rules.note: Only exploitable when PHP-CGI is used on Windows; confirm the deployment mode before treating this as confirmed.

rules.title: Jenkins CLI arbitrary file read (CVE-2024-23897)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Jenkins 2.442 or LTS 2.426.3 or later; disable the CLI if it is not needed.

rules.title: jQuery XSS via HTML manipulation (CVE-2020-11022/11023)
rules.remediation: Upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later and review untrusted HTML passed to .html()/.append().

rules.title: GitLab account takeover via password reset (CVE-2023-7028)
Confluence template injection / RCE (CVE-2023-22527)
rules.remediation: Upgrade Confluence Data Center/Server to 8.5.4 or later.

rules.title: GeoServer OGC property-name RCE (CVE-2024-36401)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to GeoServer 2.22.6 / 2.23.6 / 2.24.4 / 2.25.2 or later, or remove gt-complex-x.y.jar.

rules.title: Apache Tomcat partial PUT RCE / file disclosure (CVE-2025-24813)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Tomcat 9.0.99 / 10.1.35 / 11.0.3 or later; disable partial PUT and default-servlet writes.

rules.title: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat file read/inclusion (CVE-2020-1938)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Tomcat 7.0.100 / 8.5.51 / 9.0.31 or later; disable the AJP connector or require a secret.

rules.title: Apache Tomcat PUT JSP upload (CVE-2017-12615)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Tomcat 7.0.80 / 8.0.45 / 8.5.16 / 9.0.0.M22 or later; disable HTTP PUT.

rules.title: WordPress WP_Query SQL injection (CVE-2022-21661)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to WordPress 5.8.3 or the fixed release for your branch.

rules.title: Jira custom field/SLA information disclosure (CVE-2020-14179)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Jira Server/Data Center 8.5.8 / 8.11.1 or later.

rules.title: Jira user enumeration (CVE-2020-14181)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Jira Server/Data Center 7.13.6 / 8.5.7 / 8.12.0 or later.

rules.title: Jira Server template injection (CVE-2019-11581)
rules.remediation: Upgrade to Jira Server 7.6.14 / 7.13.5 / 8.0.3 / 8.1.2 / 8.2.3 or later.
